raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The MiniMax-M3 score-only prefill indexer (`_flash_attn_fwd_with_block_score_kernel`) runs one CTA per (query tile, index head) over the whole prefix, so a short turn over a long context runs on a few CTAs while running decodes wait. In an nsys capture on GB300, a 305-token turn over 80,512 cached tokens ran on 3 CTAs and spent 148 of the 169 ms prefill window in this kernel.

## Modifications

- A third grid axis splits the score-only causal K range into contiguous K-tile ranges; no softmax state spans K tiles, so nothing is merged and each score is written once with one split's arithmetic.
- Split count: `flash_prefill_with_topk_index` aims for about 8 CTAs per SM, capped at the K tiles; the new `num_kv_splits` argument overrides it.
- Unchanged: the callers, the index-value path and the gfx950 score-only kernel (#36546); gfx942 runs the split without AMD CI coverage.
- Prior art: AMD draft #39466 (same split for gfx950, never landed).

## Accuracy Tests

- New `test_minimax_sparse_prefill_topk_idx.py` (10 pass on GB300): scores and top-k ids bit-identical to one split (short turns, mixed batch, 16K chunk, fp8 K, lse, 2/7/4096 splits); one case also checks the scores against an fp32 reference.
- The existing MiniMax sparse kernel tests (54) pass.
- GSM8K: MiniMax-M3-NVFP4, TP4, both servers back to back on one GB300 node, sgl-eval 0.1.3 cookbook settings + `--max-tokens 32768`.

| | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K 1319 q | 97.19 % | 96.82 % |
| GSM8K 100 q, one request at a time | 100 % | 100 % |

The 5-question gap is inside one binomial SE of the difference between two temperature-1.0 runs (±0.66 points); the block scores are bit-identical to one split.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Score + top-k, bf16, one layer, one TP4 rank, one request, GB300, cold L2 (`marker.do_bench`, like the new `bench_minimax_prefill_index_score.py`):

| prefix × new | one split ms | split-KV ms | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 80,512 × 305 | 2.172 | 0.090 | 24.1× |
| 900,000 × 1,000 | 24.086 | 1.927 | 12.5× |
| 200,000 × 16,384 | 8.652 | 7.555 | 1.15× |

End to end: InferenceX AgentX c24 on one 4× GB300 tray, the two arms back to back, both with EAGLE3 #43804 at synthetic acceptance length 2.78, #45451 and fp8 KV. The with-PR arm is this PR's first revision, at 4 CTAs per SM; 8 matches it on short turns and is faster on long chunks.

| c24 | tok/s/user (1000 / p90 ITL) | total tok/s/GPU | p90 TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|
| without this PR | 78.2 | 22,770 | 2.01 s |
| with this PR | 94.6 | 24,134 | 1.83 s |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation (no user-facing change).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+"""Benchmark: MiniMax-M3 score-only prefill indexer, one split vs the split-KV launch.
+
+Score + top-k for one request over a cached prefix, one index head per rank (TP4).
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.benchmark import marker
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.minimax_sparse.common.utils import get_cu_seqblocks
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.minimax_sparse.prefill.flash_with_topk_idx import (
+    flash_prefill_with_topk_index,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(
+    est_time=30, stage="base-b-kernel-benchmark", runner_config="1-gpu-large"
+)
+
+HD, BLK, TOPK, PAGE = 128, 128, 16, 128
+SPLITS = {"one_split": 1, "split_kv": None}
+
+
+def _index_step(
+    q, k_cache, req_to_token, slot_ids, cu_seqlens, seq_lens, prefix_lens, **static
+):
+    return flash_prefill_with_topk_index(
+        q=q,
+        k_cache=k_cache,
+        v_cache=None,
+        sink=None,
+        req_to_token=req_to_token,
+        slot_ids=slot_ids,
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens,
+        prefix_lens=prefix_lens,
+        **static,
+    )
+
+
+@marker.parametrize(
+    "prefix,new",
+    [(80_512, 305), (124_928, 773), (250_000, 1_536), (200_000, 16_384)],
+    [(80_512, 305), (200_000, 16_384)],
+)
+@marker.benchmark("impl", list(SPLITS))
+def benchmark(prefix: int, new: int, impl: str):
+    width = prefix + new
+    pages = (width + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
+    slots = torch.randperm(pages, device="cuda")[:, None] * PAGE + torch.arange(
+        PAGE, device="cuda"
+    )
+    cu_seqlens = torch.tensor([0, new], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    args = (
+        torch.randn(new, 1, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"),
+        torch.randn(pages * PAGE, 1, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"),
+        slots.reshape(1, -1)[:, :width].to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+        torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        cu_seqlens,
+        torch.tensor([width], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        torch.tensor([prefix], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    # Precomputed so the captured call never syncs on the host.
+    cu_seqblocks_q, max_seqblock_q, all_seqblock_q, *_ = get_cu_seqblocks(
+        cu_seqlens, new, 1, BLK, [new]
+    )
+    static = dict(
+        max_seqlen_q=new,
+        max_seqlen_k=width,
+        block_size_q=1,
+        block_size_k=BLK,
+        topk=TOPK,
+        init_blocks=0,
+        local_blocks=1,
+        score_type="max",
+        disable_index_value=True,
+        page_size=PAGE,
+        cu_seqblocks_q=cu_seqblocks_q,
+        max_seqblock_q=max_seqblock_q,
+        all_seqblock_q=all_seqblock_q,
+        num_kv_splits=SPLITS[impl],
+    )
+    return marker.do_bench(
+        _index_step,
+        input_args=args,
+        input_kwargs=static,
+        graph_clone_kwargs=None,
+        memory_args=(args[1],),
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    benchmark.run()

@@ -0,0 +1,144 @@
+"""Score-only prefill indexer: split-KV block scores and top-k equal one split's."""
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.minimax_sparse.prefill.flash_with_topk_idx import (
+    flash_prefill_with_topk_index,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="4-gpu-b200")
+
+HD, BLK, TOPK, PAGE = 128, 128, 16, 128
+
+# (cached prefix, new tokens) per request
+CASES = {
+    # a few (q tile, head) CTAs per request without splits
+    "short_turns": [(80_512, 305), (124_928, 773)],
+    "mixed_batch": [(0, 2_000), (5_000, 1), (300_000, 1_536), (777, 129)],
+    "full_chunk": [(200_000, 16_384)],
+}
+DTYPES = {
+    "bf16": (torch.bfloat16, torch.bfloat16),
+    "fp8_k": (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.bfloat16),  # widening: bf16 q, fp8 index K
+    "fp8_qk": (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e4m3fn),  # fp8 attn-GEMM mode
+}
+
+
+def _inputs(reqs, k_dtype, q_dtype, seed=0):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    batch = len(reqs)
+    seq = [p + n for p, n in reqs]
+    width = max(seq)
+    pages_per_req = (width + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
+    pages = torch.randperm(batch * pages_per_req, device="cuda")
+    slots = pages.view(batch, pages_per_req, 1) * PAGE + torch.arange(
+        PAGE, device="cuda"
+    )
+    total_q = sum(n for _, n in reqs)
+    cu_seqlens = torch.zeros(batch + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    cu_seqlens[1:] = torch.tensor([n for _, n in reqs], device="cuda").cumsum(0)
+    return dict(
+        q=torch.randn(total_q, 1, HD, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda").to(q_dtype),
+        k_cache=torch.randn(batch * pages_per_req * PAGE, 1, HD, device="cuda").to(
+            k_dtype
+        ),
+        v_cache=None,
+        sink=None,
+        req_to_token=slots.reshape(batch, -1)[:, :width].to(torch.int32).contiguous(),
+        slot_ids=torch.arange(batch, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor(seq, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        prefix_lens=torch.tensor(
+            [p for p, _ in reqs], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+        ),
+        max_seqlen_q=max(n for _, n in reqs),
+        max_seqlen_k=width,
+        block_size_q=1,
+        block_size_k=BLK,
+        topk=TOPK,
+        init_blocks=0,
+        local_blocks=1,
+        disable_index_value=True,
+        page_size=PAGE,
+        k_scale=0.75 if k_dtype != torch.bfloat16 else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _run(monkeypatch, kwargs, splits, score_type="max"):
+    # The block-score buffer is the call's only float32 -inf torch.full.
+    scores = []
+    orig_full = torch.full
+
+    def full(size, fill_value, *args, **kw):
+        out = orig_full(size, fill_value, *args, **kw)
+        if kw.get("dtype") == torch.float32 and fill_value == float("-inf"):
+            scores.append(out)
+        return out
+
+    with monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.setattr(torch, "full", full)
+        _, topk_idx = flash_prefill_with_topk_index(
+            **kwargs, score_type=score_type, num_kv_splits=splits
+        )
+    assert len(scores) == 1
+    return topk_idx, scores[0]
+
+
+def _check(monkeypatch, kwargs, splits, score_type="max"):
+    want_idx, want_score = _run(monkeypatch, kwargs, 1, score_type)
+    got_idx, got_score = _run(monkeypatch, kwargs, splits, score_type)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got_score, want_score, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(got_idx, want_idx, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", list(CASES))
+def test_default_split_matches_one_split(monkeypatch, case):
+    _check(monkeypatch, _inputs(CASES[case], *DTYPES["bf16"]), None)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dtypes,score_type", [("fp8_k", "max"), ("fp8_qk", "max"), ("bf16", "lse")]
+)
+def test_default_split_fp8_and_lse(monkeypatch, dtypes, score_type):
+    _check(
+        monkeypatch, _inputs(CASES["short_turns"], *DTYPES[dtypes]), None, score_type
+    )
+
+
+def test_scores_match_reference(monkeypatch):
+    reqs = [(300, 77), (0, 200)]
+    kwargs = _inputs(reqs, *DTYPES["bf16"])
+    _, score = _run(monkeypatch, kwargs, None)
+    want = torch.full_like(score, float("-inf"))
+    q_start = 0
+    for b, (prefix, new) in enumerate(reqs):
+        seq = prefix + new
+        k = kwargs["k_cache"][kwargs["req_to_token"][b, :seq].long(), 0].float()
+        q = kwargs["q"][q_start : q_start + new, 0].float()
+        # The kernel scores in log2 units: q . k * sm_scale * log2(e).
+        qk = (q[:, None, :] * k[None, :, :]).sum(-1) * (HD**-0.5 * 1.4426950409)
+        causal = torch.arange(seq, device="cuda")[None, :] <= (
+            prefix + torch.arange(new, device="cuda")[:, None]
+        )
+        qk = qk.masked_fill(~causal, float("-inf"))
+        blocks = triton.cdiv(seq, BLK)
+        qk = torch.nn.functional.pad(qk, (0, blocks * BLK - seq), value=float("-inf"))
+        want[0, q_start : q_start + new, :blocks] = qk.view(new, blocks, BLK).amax(-1)
+        q_start += new
+    torch.testing.assert_close(score, want, rtol=1e-3, atol=1e-3)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("splits", [2, 7, 4096])
+def test_explicit_split_counts(monkeypatch, splits):
+    """Counts that do not divide the K tiles, and the clamp to the K tiles."""
+    _check(monkeypatch, _inputs(CASES["mixed_batch"], *DTYPES["bf16"]), splits)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
